name: PMU box
where: under the dash, driver-side footwell, its lid reachable for the fuses and its plugs facing down or sideways (rules water-ingress) - the space assumed until M-1 (D-603)
holds: the PMU-24 DL on its own 39-way plug, its case one outside wall (D-596); eight smart high-side switches in place of K1-K4, K11, K12, K14, K15 and K13 a relay in a socket (D-597, D-352); the windows' two H-bridges in place of K5-K8 (D-610); the big-fuse bank F30, F31, F32, F35, F36 and the mini-blade bank F1, F2, F3, F5, F12, F13, F15, F16, F19, F20, F21, F22, F23, F24, F33, F37 (D-597, D-599); the wake circuit (wake_stages) and the A15 / A16 pull-ups, the oil-pressure pull-up with A7's tap, the pop-up diodes, the main-feed TVS (P136), the ground star; at the LS swap the ECU, the EMU PRO, on its own pigtails (D-601)
joins: plugs L1-E1, L1-E2, L1-E3 (engine, wired for the LS from day one, D-606, D-607), L2-F1 (front), L4-R1 (rear); hard-wired, with a plug only at the far end: L3-COL, L3-DASH, L3-HU and the links to DP-ICU, DP-DCU, DP-DCU-P, DP-CUR, L3-SD, L3-SP, D1, D2, DP-DIAG, L3-BLW, L3-MOD; the 2 AWG feed on a stud; one heavy ground lead from its star to a chassis ground point outside it (D-603)
note: Its board, enclosure and heat budget are the CAD pass's (Y69).

name: Display Unit
holds: the 12.3-inch display, the BT817 board, the DU carrier (ICU in the tables, D-496), the radio; the AEM wideband gauge whole, in its case, on its own feed and ground, its CAN on the DU's CAN2 pair inside (D-596)
joins: DP-ICU, a DRC 24-way (D-587); a sealed gland for the gauge's sensor lead
note: The gauge's place and the gland are the CAD pass's (Y72).

name: Control Unit
where: the centre stack under the stereo, its box stepping up behind the dash and fitted from behind (D-604)
holds: the CU carrier (DCU in the tables), the face board behind the eighth-pass face (D-602), the seats' heat and cool on + side smart switches with no fuses (D-597), the radar receiver once picked small enough (D-597), the CAN2 chain's far-end 120 ohm terminator
joins: DP-DCU, the DRC 64-way header with a 24-way and a 40-way plug (D-594); DP-DCU-P, a DTP 2-way power inlet for the comfort feed and its return (D-612)
note: The carrier and face board are redrawn at the CAD pass (Y70).

name: Control Unit Remote
where: right of the steering wheel, high beside the DU (D-586)
holds: the CUR board: the screen knob, the mirror stick, the hazard, both winks, the fuel-door and hatch keys, an I/O expander and an I2C ADC so the keys and stick ride the I2C bus (D-604)
joins: DP-CUR, one DRC 24-way (D-597): four wires to the CU, five to the PMU box
note: Its board is redrawn at the CAD pass (Y71).

name: Bin box
where: the passenger-side cargo bin, in the battery tray beside the battery, held down as the battery is (D-063, D-608)
holds: the master disconnect, its knob through the lid (D-319); the Class-T 150 A; the 2151 dual MRBF block with the starter's 250 A and the amplifier's F34 (D-560); F38; a negative bus
joins: two booted battery leads tightened onto the battery's brass terminals (D-235, P095); four bolted studs under the lid: the 2 AWG PMU feed (C03), the 1/0 starter feed (C04), the 1/0 cranking return (C11), the chassis bond to the rear ground stud (C05); the amplifier dock's two bolted leads (C13, C14) (D-609)
note: Its mock-up round the Ionic S9 and the tray is the CAD pass's (Y73).

name: Bay junction
where: the engine bay, on the body where the starter feed arrives, so the LS swap leaves it alone (D-609)
holds: the covered positive jump post, the ground post beside it, F17 and F18 (MIDI), the start relay K9 (D-609)
joins: C04 in from the bin box; C15 on to the starter's B+ stud; the alternator's B+ through F18 (C07); K9's coil from L1-E1 5; the ground post bonded to the engine block
note: Being jumped or charged through the post: the S9's own emergency-start reserve first, 14.6 V at most, never used to jump another car until Ionic says so, its charge-current limit asked of Ionic (D-609). Its mock-up is the CAD pass's (Y74).

name: Amplifier dock
where: against the bin box in the passenger-side cargo bin, its fins in open air away from the battery (D-609)
holds: the DSP amplifier (luxury LP57, not picked) and the home-built upmix (LP56) built as its connector board, the digital link between them inside (D-503, D-609)
joins: L4-AMP, one HDP20 24-29: every speaker output, the head unit's line-level pair with its drain, the remote; power by two short bolted leads from the bin box (C13 from F34, C14 to the negative bus)
note: Its board waits on the amplifier's pick (luxury X-012), then the CAD pass (Y75).
